source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the adrenal glands (PDF 66-67).

blocks.text: Har gurde (kidney) ke bilkul oopar ek adrenal gland hota hai. Har gland ka andar wala hissa adrenal medulla aur bahar wali teh adrenal cortex kehlati hai.

blocks.alt: Baen: gurda jis ke oopar adrenal gland topi ki tarah rakha hai. Teer daen taraf adrenal gland ki tarash tak jata hai: bahar patla capsule (ghilaf), mota peela cortex, aur andar gehra medulla jis mein khoon ki nalyan (blood vessels) hain.
blocks.caption: Figure 16.5: Adrenal gland (kitab ki Figure 16.5 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Baen taraf gurde ke oopar adrenal gland topi ki tarah rakha hai. Teer us ki tarash (section) ki taraf jata hai: sab se bahar patla capsule (ghilaf), us ke neeche mota peela cortex, aur beech mein gehra medulla jis mein khoon ki nalyan hain. Yaad rakhein: cortex bahar hai aur medulla andar.
